# 🛠️ Setup Guide  
**Author:** [Nate Herk](https://www.youtube.com/@nateherk)

Follow these steps to get the n8n workflow system running smoothly:

### ✅ Step 1: Connect Your Google Drive Credentials  
Make sure your **Google Drive trigger** is authorized and set to watch the appropriate folder for new file drops.

### ✅ Step 2: Connect Your Supabase Credentials  
Hook up your **Supabase** project so n8n can insert and manage vector data.

### ✅ Step 3: Connect Your Chat & Embeddings Models  
Use [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) for flexible model access and [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/) for embedding generation.

### ✅ Step 4: Drop a Doc into the Trigger Folder  
Upload a file into the folder being watched by **Pipeline 1** (new doc trigger). Confirm it’s inserted into Supabase and available to your agents.

### ✅ Step 5: Update the Doc  
Modify the same document. This should trigger **Pipeline 2 (update doc)**, which should:  
- Remove old rows from Supabase  
- Insert the new version cleanly

### ✅ Step 6: Move the File to the Recycling Bin  
Drag the document into the "recycling bin" folder. This should trigger **Pipeline 3 (delete doc)** and clean up the corresponding vectors in Supabase.

### 🧪 Final Step: Test and Iterate  
Try different document types and metadata formats. Make sure your agents can accurately retrieve and respond to your queries.
https://youtu.be/5uw1wE6niGc

assignments.value: MediaCraft AI Comprehensive Knowledge Base for RAG Chatbot 1. Core Offering and Value Proposition MediaCraft AI is a smart, user-friendly AI image and video creation platform designed to help businesses, creators, and entrepreneurs transform ordinary visuals into polished, professional marketing assets quickly and efficiently [1]. The platform emphasizes that no design skills are needed to create stunning marketing materials in seconds [1].   The core value proposition is the ability to:   * Transform ordinary photos into stunning marketing materials in seconds [1]. * Provide a user-friendly platform that eliminates the need for design skills [1]. 2. Service Models MediaCraft AI offers two distinct service models to cater to different user needs [1]: A. DIY Platform This model is ideal for entrepreneurs and small businesses who prefer to have control over the creative process [1].   * Process: Users upload their image and describe the desired outcome, and the AI performs the transformation [1]. B. Done-For-You This is a premium service where MediaCraft AI experts handle the entire process [1].   * Process: Users send their images and requirements to the expert team. * Key Service Metrics: Professional results are delivered within 24 hours, and the service includes Unlimited Revisions [1].   ________________   3. How to Use MediaCraft AI (DIY Platform Workflow) The DIY Platform utilizes an asynchronous, email-based delivery workflow for its AI generation services (Image and Video). The process is designed to be simple and efficient, ensuring users can submit requests quickly without waiting for the generation process to complete [Workflow Analysis]. 5 Simple Steps to Create Your AI-Powered Visuals The entire process, from submission to delivery, is handled in five key steps:   Step 	Action 	Description 	1. Submit Request 	User provides Full Name, Your Email, and a detailed Requested edit (text prompt). An image file can be optionally uploaded for editing or Image-to-Video. 	  	2. Immediate Confirmation 	The platform sends an instant success message, confirming the request is received and in the processing queue. The user can close the page. 	  	3. AI Generation 	The backend system uses AI models (Gemini 2.5 Flash for images, Sora 2/Veo 3.1 for video) to generate content based on the prompt. 	  	4. File Preparation 	The final file is saved to a secure cloud storage (Google Drive), and a public, shareable download link is generated. 	  	5. Email Notification 	The user receives a professional email with a personalized greeting and the direct download link. Delivery is typically 30-90 seconds for images and longer for video. 	  	  ________________   4. Detailed Tutorial for AI Video Generation The video generation process uses state-of-the-art models like Sora 2 and Veo 3.1. Generation Paths * Text-to-Video: AI generates a video entirely from a text description (no source image provided). * Image-to-Video: AI uses a submitted image as a starting point and animates it based on the text prompt. Tips for Writing Effective Prompts The quality of the final video is heavily dependent on the detail and clarity of your text prompt.   Prompt Tip 	Description 	Example of Effective Prompt 	Be Specific 	Clearly define the subject, action, environment, and style. Use rich adjectives to describe mood and texture. 	"A majestic golden retriever running through a field of purple lavender at sunset, cinematic lighting, 4K resolution." 	Define the Action 	Use strong verbs to describe the movement or change you want to see. Specify the speed or direction if important. 	"A close-up shot of a vintage clock's gears slowly turning, with dust motes floating in the light." 	Specify Visual Style 	Include keywords for artistic style, camera work, and quality. This guides the AI's aesthetic choices. 	"A futuristic city skyline at night, cyberpunk style, neon glow, wide-angle shot, high-contrast." 	Set the Aspect Ratio 	Specify your desired ratio (e.g., 16:9 for landscape, or 9:16 for vertical social media shorts). 	"A vibrant food truck festival, shot in 9:16 vertical format, slow-motion." 	  ________________   5. Customer Use Cases MediaCraft AI supports a wide range of creative and marketing tasks through its AI image and video generation capabilities [Workflow Analysis].   Use Case Category 	Description 	  	Product Mockups & Visuals 	Generate high-quality product images for e-commerce, social media, or advertising. This includes changing backgrounds, enhancing details, or placing products in new scenes. 	  	Marketing Content Creation 	Create entirely new images from scratch based on a text description (Text-to-Image), such as a "futuristic city with flying cars" or a "modern minimalist logo." 	  	Social Media & Ad Videos 	Generate short, engaging video clips for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. This includes both Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video generation. 	  	Visual Storytelling 	Transform a static image into a dynamic video (Image-to-Video) to bring a scene or product to life, adding motion and visual interest. 	  	Image Enhancement & Editing 	Upload an existing image and request a specific edit, such as "change the color of the car to red" or "remove the person in the background." 	Image Generation (Gemini 2.5 Flash) 	  ________________   6. Pricing and Plans MediaCraft AI's pricing is structured across three main plans, utilizing both per-image and credit-based systems [1]:   Plan 	Pricing 	Service Model 	Key Features 	DIY Basic 	₦100/image (approx. $1.00) 	DIY Platform 	AI Image Enhancement, Background Removal, Basic Templates, Instant Download [1]. 	DIY Pro 	₦2000/500 AI Credits (approx. $5/500 AI Credits) 	DIY Platform 	Premium Templates, Batch Processing, Priority Support (all features powered by AI Credits) [1]. 	Done-For-You 	Contact Us 	Done-For-You Service 	Expert Enhancement, Custom Edits, 24hr Delivery, Unlimited Revisions [1]. 	  Credits System:   * New sign-ups receive 100 FREE AI Credits instantly [1]. * The DIY Pro plan operates on an AI Credits system, where 500 AI Credits cost ₦2000 [1].   ________________   7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) This section provides answers to the most common questions a user of the RAG chatbot would likely ask, based on the website content and workflow analysis [1]. General 1. What is MediaCraft AI?      * Answer: MediaCraft AI is an AI image and video creation platform that helps businesses and entrepreneurs quickly turn ordinary visuals into professional marketing content without needing design skills [1].   2. Who is MediaCraft AI for?      * Answer: It is designed for businesses, creators, and entrepreneurs who need to create polished marketing assets efficiently [1].   3. Do I need design skills to use the platform?      * Answer: No, the platform is user-friendly and designed so that no prior design experience is required [1]. Service Models 4. What is the difference between the DIY Platform and the Done-For-You service?      * Answer: The DIY Platform gives you full control: you upload your image and describe the changes, and the AI does the magic. The Done-For-You service is handled by MediaCraft AI experts, who take your images and requirements and deliver professional, custom-edited results within 24 hours [1].   5. How fast is the Done-For-You service?      * Answer: The experts aim to deliver professional results within 24 hours [1]. Pricing and Credits 6. How much does MediaCraft AI cost?      * Answer: Pricing depends on the plan: DIY Basic is ₦100 per image; DIY Pro is ₦2000 for 500 AI Credits; and the Done-For-You service requires contacting the team for a quote [1].   7. What are AI Credits?      * Answer: AI Credits are used in the DIY Pro plan to process images. New users get 100 FREE AI Credits upon sign-up. 500 AI Credits cost ₦2000 [1].   8. What features are included in the DIY Basic plan?      * Answer: The DIY Basic plan includes AI Image Enhancement, Background Removal, Basic Templates, and Instant Download [1].   9. What features are included in the DIY Pro plan?      * Answer: The DIY Pro plan includes access to Premium Templates, Batch Processing, and Priority Support, in addition to the basic features, all powered by AI Credits [1].   10. Does the Done-For-You service include revisions?      * Answer: Yes, the Done-For-You service includes Unlimited Revisions [1]. References MediaCraft AI. Transform Images with AI Magic. https://mediacraftai.com/

# 🌍 Multilingual eCommerce Customer Service Chatbot (n8n Workflow)

This workflow creates a **multilingual eCommerce chatbot** that automatically detects the customer’s language and provides tailored responses. It is designed for online shops to improve customer support in English, Spanish, and French.

The chatbot is powered by **OpenAI’s GPT-5 Nano** and runs entirely inside **n8n**, with built-in memory to keep conversations contextual and helpful.

## ⚙️ Setup Instructions

### 1️⃣ Set Up OpenAI Connection
#### Get API Key
1. Go to [OpenAI Platform](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)  
2. Go to [OpenAI Billing](https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/overview)  
3. Add funds to your billing account  
4. Copy your API key into the **OpenAI credentials** in n8n  

### 2️⃣ Configure Your Languages & Prompts
- Open the **Set Node** named `Ecommerce Language Prompts`.  
- Update or expand the list of languages and their **system prompts**.  
- Example already includes:  
  - English  
  - Spanish  
  - French
